presenze.title: Attendance

timbrature.title: Clock-ins

richieste.title: Requests and approvals
richieste.text: Holidays, leave and justifications reach the right manager.

noteSpese.title: Expense reports

clienti.title: Customers and contacts

agenda.title: Agenda and reminders

permessi.title: Permissions and privacy

assistente.title: Assistant and manuals

scelta.domanda: Do I have to activate all the applications?
scelta.risposta: No: you activate only the ones you need and add the others whenever you want.

dati.risposta: Yes: customers and employees are a single registry used by all active applications.

installare.domanda: Do I need to install anything?
installare.risposta: No, it works from the browser and the smartphone.

consulente.risposta: Yes, the firm follows your companies with its own access.
